listing.name: Half-Life (Xash3D FWGS)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native cross-platform engine with current continuous binary packages. Limits: Original valve data and compatible HLSDK game library; separate game targets/mods only with evidence. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux official continuous packages default to x86/32-bit on x86 hosts for Half-Life compatibility. x86/ARM and other platform source ports documented; CPU/game-library pairing matters. Original data: Original valve data and compatible HLSDK game library; separate game targets/mods only with evidence. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
